_comment: CAPABILITY REGISTRY. Every entry was verified by reading the file at the stated line. A capability listed here EXISTS and is PROVEN. It is never rebuilt, never duplicated, and never removed. scripts/verify-no-capability-regression.mjs reads this file and fails the build if any symbol is gone from its file. To retire a capability you delete its entry here in the SAME PR, with the reason in the PR body, so the removal is visible and owner-reviewable. Silent disappearance is the regression this file exists to stop.
_law: Additive-only. Never delete or remove modules, pages, sidebar entries, sections, cards, fields, columns, tabs, routes or features. Only add. The only exception is the owner saying 'remove X' in words.

expenses, work orders, governance void executors

THE settlement number. Bare continuing AlwaysTrack integer, no prefix, no padding, floor 5803. Delegates to allocateNextSettlementSourceDocumentRef. Imported by exactly 6 files. Any call site minting its own number is a defect.
